description: Common questions a developer asks the zitadel CLI, run as one stateful journey against a single project. Each stage is a fresh agent task sharing the project and server the earlier stages built. The agent drives the CLI non-interactively, but may converse with the user: a stage with a `user` persona is run as a multi-turn conversation where a simulated user answers the agent's questions from that persona. Each stage grades on OUTCOME: after the agent's turn, the harness runs the stage's `assert` list against the live local instance (read commands, `--json`) and the stage passes only if every assertion holds. `grade` is a fallback for stages that have no server-assertable outcome.

stages.title: Set up a project (agent elicits the fields + sign-in method)
stages.prompt: I want to add sign-up and sign-in to the app in this directory using Zitadel. Set up a new Zitadel project and apply it to a running local server. This is my app, so ask me whatever you need to decide how sign-up and sign-in should work rather than guessing.
stages.user: You are the developer who owns this app. You want people to sign up with their first name and last name, and sign in with a password. You do NOT want passkeys or single sign-on yet. Answer the agent's questions briefly and concretely from these preferences, and don't volunteer requirements it didn't ask about.

assert.name: a project exists on the instance
deployed schema collects a first name
deployed schema collects a last name
passkeys are NOT enabled (the developer said no)

stages.title: List all the projects
stages.prompt: Using the zitadel CLI in this directory, list all the projects and tell me what you find. Drive the CLI non-interactively.

stages.title: Does my project have a client id and secret?
stages.prompt: Using the zitadel CLI in this directory, does my project have a client id and a client secret? Check and tell me yes or no, with the evidence you used. Drive the CLI non-interactively.

stages.title: Add a telephone number field + deploy
stages.prompt: Using the zitadel CLI in this directory, add a telephone number field to my user schema and deploy the change. Drive the CLI non-interactively.

assert.name: a phone field is live on the deployed schema

stages.title: Enable passkeys + deploy
stages.prompt: Using the zitadel CLI in this directory, enable passkeys for my users and deploy the change. Drive the CLI non-interactively.

assert.name: passkeys are enabled on the deployed schema
